source: The Strat Scanner's published labels for the stocks in the daily scoring run, labelled by a working copy of the published TheStrat bar-pattern rules
sessions_note: This wire carries 1 session. The record names hammer, shooter and failed shapes only for its freshest session, 2026-11-12, even though it carries plain labels for the last 5 sessions, so every entry here is dated to that one session.
proving_note: Still being proven: this scanner's labels have no forward record yet. The labels below name the pattern each name's bars showed on the day; nothing has graded what happened after them, and the page makes no claim about what follows a label.
coverage: 1,809 of the 1,833 names in the daily scoring run were labelled for 2026-11-12; 24 had no bar that day and show nothing; the price history on record holds 413 sessions, from 2025-03-25 to 2026-11-12

kind_words.label: Hammer shape
kind_words.words: Hammer shape: the whole body of the day's bar, from its open to its close, sits in the top third of the day's range.

kind_words.label: Shooter shape
kind_words.words: Shooter shape: the whole body of the day's bar, from its open to its close, sits in the bottom third of the day's range.

kind_words.label: Failed 2-up
kind_words.words: Failed 2-up: the bar took the day before's high but closed below where it opened.

kind_words.label: Failed 2-down
kind_words.words: Failed 2-down: the bar took the day before's low but closed above where it opened.
